description: Recover one checksum-verified AI SENSE audio message, the audio-v2 format or the earlier v1, from a PCM16 WAV recording at 44100 or 48000 Hz, mono or stereo, at most 40 seconds. Give storage_id for a WAV file of at most 4 MiB, uploaded through REST Storage first. WAV recordings exceed the inline MCP request limit. REST accepts files up to 8 MiB. Answers data_base64, byte_length and text when the recovered bytes are valid UTF-8. This is data-over-sound decoding, not speech transcription. Audio is processed by the API, and the decoded result is not stored. Stored input keeps its original lifetime. storage_id must name an ordinary 24-hour file, without a max_downloads limit. No API key, no account and no sign up.

mode.description: auto tries all three bands within one shared time limit, and the earlier v1 format only in audible. Pick audible, high or ultrasound when known.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

name: decode_audio
title: Decode data from sound
